answer: A protocol detects sybils via correlated liveness. Each epoch participants submit signed heartbeats; presence forms a binary stream per pubkey. After N epochs pairwise correlation across streams is computed; clusters above a threshold are flagged and slashed. A clone farm produces a near-identical trellis of presence spikes. A whisper of desynchronization costs availability, since puppets must go offline separately to decorrelate, halving throughput. No oracle is needed; the protocol anchor is the statistical fingerprint of synchronized behavior, making collusion visible without a registrar.
